description:
The CT Cranium DICOM dataset is loaded. A 3D printing lab needs two models: one 'raw' export containing all bone fragments (for analysis) and one 'cleaned' export containing only the main skull (for printing). 

1. Create a mask using the 'Bone' preset (226-3071 HU).
2. Open the 3D Surface generation options. Uncheck/Disable 'Keep largest region' so all fragments are included, generate the surface, and export it as a binary STL to '/home/ga/Documents/bone_raw.stl'.
3. Change the 3D Surface options to Check/Enable 'Keep largest region', generate a new surface, and export it as a binary STL to '/home/ga/Documents/bone_cleaned.stl'.

Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
